The '''Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station''' was a space station that orbited [[Gus Treta/Legends|Gus Treta]], one of the three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It made one full orbit five times a [[Standard day/Legends|day]], or once every 4.8 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. It was noted for providing a wealth of services to the five worlds that were its neighbors. The station started life as the wreckage of the ''[[Xim's Scion]]'', a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] destroyed in a skirmish with the [[Corellian Security Force]] several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A group of enterprising [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] towed the forward 250-meter portion of the cruiser into an elliptical orbit around Gus Treta, and converted into a refueling depot and market over the following years. When he purchased the station, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gormo Vosadii Grasso]] worked with the ''Scion''{{'s}} builders [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] to stack modular expansions atop the station.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

[[Jagged Antilles]] and his wife [[Zena Antilles|Zena]] owned and operated a [[Gus Treta fueling station|fuel depot]] on the station, and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' early life was split attending school on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and working aboard the Gus Treta with his family.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

The station was nearly destroyed in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]] when the [[Bonestar Pirates|Bonestar Pirate]] [[Loka Hask]], who was trying to escape from [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]], purposely lifted off while the refueling lines were still attached his ship, [[Buzzzer (starship)|''Buzzzer'']]. The resulting explosion threatened to destroy the Gus Treta. Most of the space station was ultimately destroyed, but some portions were saved thanks to Jagged and Zena, who sacrificed themselves to limit the destruction of the station and save those aboard.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />
